summary: Filana Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 announcing the FDA lifted the full clinical hold on its IND for simufilam in tuberous sclerosis complex-related epilepsy. No transaction terms, stake, price or advisor were disclosed. The planned Phase 2a is a 16-week multicenter, randomized, double-blind trial of two doses at 13 U.S. sites targeting 40 subjects aged 12 to 55, with a 48-week extension; screening expected to begin by Q1 2027. This is a routine regulatory/clinical update, not a special situation; watch enrollment timing and safety data.
